description_en: Upgrades the minor version of a cluster by calling UpgradeMinorVersion
description_zh: 集群通过UpgradeMinorVersion进行小版本升级
kebab_example: aliyun hbase upgrade-minor-version --cluster-id hb-t4naqsay5gn0000 --components HADOOP --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeMinorVersion

parameters.description_en: The names of the components to upgrade. Separate multiple component names with commas (,).
parameters.description_zh: 要升级的组件名称，多个组件中间逗号隔开。
parameters.help_en: The names of the components to upgrade. Separate multiple component names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要升级的组件名称，多个组件中间逗号隔开
parameters.name: components
